snippet.title: How to use Eleventy paired shortcodes
snippet.description:
Nunjucks and Liquid allow you to create reusable pieces of content via shortcodes within Eleventy. Shortcodes are defined in your eleventy config and can be used in your templates or markdown files.


In this tutorial I walk you through making a reusable Bootstrap alert using paired shortcodes and Nunjucks.
